newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NatSteel plans to list electronics unit.
newsitem.headline: NatSteel plans to list electronics unit.

text.p: Singapore's diversified steel group NatSteel Ltd plans to list NatSteel Electronics Pte Ltd, its printed printed circuit board assembly business, in the near future, company chief Ang Kong Hua said on Wednesday.
"Listing NatSteel Electronics is something we like to look at from the stand point of the company's need for capital," Ang told a news conference after the announcement of NatSteel's 1996 results.

Ang said NatSteel Electronics performance in recent years had met all the listing requirements of the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES), which requires a company to have a profit record for five consecutive years to qualify for mainboard listing.
NatSteel Electronics is the largest unit in the group's electronic division and contributes a huge portion of earnings, Ang said.
Last October, NatSteel listed another of its electronics unit, China-based NatSteel Broadway Ltd, at US$0.70.
NatSteel reported a 29.6 percent profit gain to Singapore $55.34 million for the year ended December 31, 1996. Turnover rose 7.8 percent to S$2.2 billion.
